description.text: , a parked car sits low and heavy, its body a faint silhouette against damp concrete. The tunnel walls curve away on both sides, their wet surfaces catching only a thin sheen from distant lamps, while the road floor recedes into a black throat ahead. The vehicle's edges are barely separable from the surrounding gloom; its glass and paint hold dull highlights, and a faint haze of exhaust hangs around the rear. Nothing yet moves except the settling air. The car sits small within the broad tunnel interior, and the darkness presses in from every side before the forward shift begins.
Low hollow tunnel ambience surrounds the stationary car.
The car rests as a faint silhouette swallowed by darkness, its edges barely separated from the surrounding gloom.
A thin haze of exhaust drifts and settles around the rear of the car.
The camera holds a static shot.

The car eases forward from its resting position, nose lifting out of the blackness. A dim wash of light grows ahead at the tunnel mouth, stretching a pale reflection along the damp road and picking out the leading edge of the hood. The tires roll slowly over the concrete, and the body remains mostly in shadow, with only intermittent highlights along the roofline and side panels. The gap between the car and the tunnel opening shortens gradually; dust motes drift through the faint beam, and the surrounding walls stay close and heavy. The motion is deliberate, a slow pull rather than a burst, and the car's silhouette begins to separate from the dark.
A soft engine hum and slow tire roll on concrete begin.
The car eases forward, drawing closer to the tunnel mouth while remaining mostly in shadow.
A dim wash of light grows ahead and catches the leading edge of the hood.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

The car pulls fully forward out of the dark into the tunnel mouth's pale edge of light. Its body gradually resolves as it rolls clear of the shadow: the hood, windshield, and flanks take on a soft sheen, while the rear of the vehicle still trails a dim smear of darkness. The tunnel opening widens around it, with the car set against a lighter exterior haze; the road surface brightens under the tires, and the last pockets of blackness fall behind. The car's motion carries it forward with slow momentum, and the scene settles as the vehicle emerges, its shape now readable against the light.
The engine hum rises slightly and air moves through the tunnel.
The car rolls clear of the shadow and emerges into the pale edge of light.
The hood, windshield, and flanks take on a soft sheen as the last darkness falls behind.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.
